# FedEx

> Global shipping, tracking, logistics, and business tools for individuals, ecommerce sellers, and enterprises.

FedEx provides localized shipping and delivery services across regions worldwide, with core experiences for package tracking, rate quotes, label creation, pickup scheduling, location finding, account management, and small business support.

## Global & Regional Entry Points

- [FedEx Global Home](https://www.fedex.com/): Global homepage for selecting country or region and accessing localized FedEx services.
- [FedEx United States Home](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/home.html): Main U.S. hub for tracking, shipping, rates, locations, and account tools.
- [FedEx Canada Home](https://www.fedex.com/en-ca/home.html): Canada homepage for shipping, tracking, and local service information.
- [FedEx Europe Home](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/europe.html): Entry point for shipping information and services related to Europe.
- [FedEx Asia Pacific Home](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/asia-pacific.html): Regional shipping information for Asia Pacific destinations and services.

## Tracking & Delivery Management

- [Tracking](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking.html): Track packages, freight, and shipments with status updates and delivery details.
- [Advanced Tracking](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/advanced.html): Monitor multiple shipments with filters, exceptions, and proof-of-delivery access.
- [Track by Tracking Number](https://www.fedex.com/fedextrack/): Direct tracking interface for package status lookup.
- [Tracking Guide](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/guide-for-tracking-managing-deliveries.html): Overview of tracking tools, delivery options, and shipment management features.
- [Delivery Manager](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/delivery-manager.html): Manage residential deliveries with alerts, holds, and delivery preferences.
- [Proof of Delivery](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/proof-of-delivery.html): Access signature and delivery confirmation documentation for completed shipments.

## Shipping Services

- [Ship Now](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping.html): Start creating shipments, labels, and delivery options online.
- [FedEx Ground](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/ground.html): U.S. ground shipping service information, transit times, and package options.
- [FedEx Express](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/express.html): Time-definite express shipping services for domestic and international deliveries.
- [FedEx Freight](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/freight.html): Freight shipping options for palletized and heavyweight shipments.
- [International Shipping](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international.html): International service options, documentation, and customs-related shipping guidance.
- [Schedule a Pickup](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/schedule-manage-pickups.html): Arrange, change, or cancel package pickups for eligible shipments.

## Rates, Transit Times & Service Tools

- [Get Rates and Transit Times](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/online/rating.html): Compare shipping rates and estimated delivery times for FedEx services.
- [Calculate Time and Cost](https://www.fedex.com/ratefinder/home): Estimate shipping costs and delivery commitments for packages and freight.
- [Service Guide](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/service-guide.html): Reference guide for FedEx services, policies, surcharges, and shipping terms.
- [Packaging Tips and Supplies](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packing.html): Guidance on packaging methods, materials, and shipment preparation.
- [Saturday Delivery Options](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/saturday-and-sunday-delivery.html): Information on weekend delivery availability and service coverage.

## Locations & Drop Off

- [Find FedEx Locations](https://www.fedex.com/locate/): Search for FedEx Office, drop boxes, staffed locations, and pickup points.
- [FedEx Office](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/office.html): Printing, packing, shipping, and business services available at FedEx Office locations.
- [Drop Off a Package](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/drop-off-package.html): Learn where and how to drop off pre-labeled shipments.
- [Hold at Location](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/hold-at-location.html): Redirect eligible packages for pickup at participating FedEx locations.
- [Pickup and Dropoff Options](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/dropoff-pickup-options.html): Compare available package handoff and collection methods.

## Account, Billing & Administration

- [Manage Your FedEx Account](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/manage-account.html): Access account settings, preferences, addresses, and shipping administration tools.
- [Sign Up or Log In](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/account.html): Account access for shipping, tracking history, and personalized tools.
- [Billing and Invoicing](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/billing.html): Manage invoices, payment options, and billing-related account tasks.
- [Address Book](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/address-book.html): Store and manage recipient and sender addresses for shipping workflows.
- [FedEx Rewards](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/rewards.html): Loyalty and rewards information for eligible shipping customers.

## Developer & API Resources

- [FedEx Developer Portal](https://developer.fedex.com/): Developer hub for APIs, credentials, onboarding, and integration resources.
- [API Documentation](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/home.html): API catalog and technical documentation for FedEx shipping and tracking integrations.
- [OAuth Credentials API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/authorization/docs.html): Authentication documentation for obtaining access tokens for FedEx APIs.
- [Track API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/track/docs.html): API reference for shipment tracking events, statuses, and delivery details.
- [Ship API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/ship/docs.html): API documentation for shipment creation, labels, and service selection.
- [Rate API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/rate/docs.html): API reference for retrieving shipping rates and transit commitments.
- [Address Validation API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/address-validation/docs.html): Validate and standardize addresses for shipping workflows.
- [Open Ship API](https://developer.fedex.com/api/en-us/catalog/open-ship/docs.html): Manage multi-piece and deferred shipment processing through FedEx APIs.

## International Shipping & Customs

- [International Shipping Hub](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international.html): Central resource for cross-border shipping services and requirements.
- [Customs Tools](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/customs-tools.html): Resources for customs documentation, duties, and clearance preparation.
- [Prepare Customs Documents](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/prepare-documents.html): Guidance for completing required international shipment paperwork.
- [International Duties and Taxes](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/duties-and-taxes.html): Overview of duty and tax responsibilities for global shipments.
- [Country or Territory Profiles](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/country-profiles.html): Destination-specific shipping requirements and service information.
- [Electronic Trade Documents](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/international/electronic-trade-documents.html): Submit customs documents electronically for eligible international shipments.

## Small Business & Ecommerce

- [FedEx Small Business Center](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/small-business.html): Resources, shipping guidance, and tools for small business operations.
- [Choose FedEx](https://choose.fedex.com/): Small business-focused shipping solutions, offers, and operational support.
- [Ecommerce Solutions](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/ecommerce.html): Tools and services for online sellers and order fulfillment workflows.
- [Packaging and Shipping Tips for Small Business](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/small-business/articles-insights/packaging-and-shipping-tips.html): Practical guidance for packing and shipping business orders efficiently.
- [Returns Solutions](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/returns.html): Create and manage return labels and reverse logistics options.

## Customer Support & Help

- [Customer Support](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support.html): Help center for shipping, tracking, billing, and service questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support/contact.html): Contact options for the appropriate FedEx support team.
- [File a Claim](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support/claims.html): Start and manage claims for lost, damaged, or missing shipments.
- [FAQ](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support/faq.html): Frequently asked questions covering common shipping and account topics.
- [Service Alerts](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/service-alerts.html): Current operational disruptions, weather impacts, and network advisories.
- [Shipping Channel](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping-channel.html): Educational videos and how-to content for shipping and logistics tasks.
